{{Top|leg}}
'''Pulsipher's laboratory''' was a [[Laboratory/Legends|room]] located near the apex of the [[Ice Citadel]] [[Neo-Crusader War Forge|war forge]] that served as a [[Scientist/Legends|scientific]] repository and area of experimentation for [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Neo-Crusader]], [[Pulsipher]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jebble]]. After bonding with the [[Muur Talisman]] aboard the ''[[Mar'eyce]]'', en route to Jebble from [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], Pulsipher was taken to his laboratory to rest once the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] had landed. It was here that the scientist discovered that he had the power to control [[rakghoul]]s—the mindless [[mutant]]s created by the Talisman.
